OPERATIONAL LESSONS (2026-09-11 double-concurrent window, merged from both sessions): (1) the HOST CLOCK can run days behind real time (machine said 2026-09-06 while HN Algolia and the arXiv API <updated> both said 2026-09-11T18:4xZ) — always anchor current_run_started_at on an external time source before fixing the scan window; (2) a scheduled automation ('ai-intelligence daily probe', 0 8 * * *) can fire mid-session and advance the checkpoint — re-read state.json/index/events/trends BEFORE writing, chain from the other run's checkpoint, and never assume the files you read at run start are still current; (3) when two sessions race, final commits must sweep the working tree (both 490a75a and daf0eab did) and a closing reconciliation pass should verify index<->files id/fingerprint equality plus bilingual completeness; (4) arXiv digests can appear EARLY (Fri 9/11 visible complete at 18:46Z) and days can be missing (no Tue 9/8 digest existed) — capture with caveats and re-sweep above the watermark next run.
